data.name: AgentChat_Description
data.value: Embeds the Governor365 Copilot Studio agent in a canvas app.

data.name: TokenEndpoint_Description
data.value: Copilot Studio Mobile App channel token endpoint.

data.name: SsoClientId_Description
data.value: Application client ID for the PCF single-page application registration.

data.name: SsoTenantId_Description
data.value: Microsoft Entra tenant ID used to acquire the token-exchange token.

data.name: SsoRedirectUri_Description
data.value: Registered SPA redirect URI for this Canvas app.

data.name: SsoLoginHint_Description
data.value: User principal name used to silently select the signed-in Power Apps account.

data.name: ContextJson_Description
data.value: Versioned JSON object describing the current canvas app context.

data.name: ContextVersion_Description
data.value: Increment this value when the app context changes.

data.name: PromptText_Description
data.value: Bounded prompt sent by a deliberate canvas app interaction.

data.name: PromptVersion_Description
data.value: Increment this value to send the current prompt text once.

data.name: UserId_Description
data.value: Stable non-secret identifier for the signed-in user.

data.name: UserDisplayName_Description
data.value: Display name shown in Web Chat.

data.name: Locale_Description
data.value: Web Chat locale such as en-US.

data.name: ConnectionStatus_Description
data.value: Current connection status: connecting, connected, or error.

data.name: LastActionName_Description
data.value: Name of the latest validated canvas action emitted by the agent.

data.name: LastActionJson_Description
data.value: Validated JSON payload for the latest canvas action.

data.name: OnAgentAction_Description
data.value: Power Fx behavior invoked when the agent emits a validated canvas action.

data.name: OnConnectionStatusChanged_Description
data.value: Power Fx behavior invoked when the Direct Line connection state changes.
